status_vocabulary.PASS: required behavior verified with retained evidence for the named tuple
status_vocabulary.FAIL: required behavior did not execute or produced incorrect output
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED: an external constraint or missing prerequisite prevents execution
status_vocabulary.NOT APPLICABLE: the requirement does not apply to this tuple
status_vocabulary.STAGED: a bounded scene or subset executed; not the full effect or profile matrix
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL: some required sub-gates pass while others remain open
status_vocabulary.OBSERVED: identity or behavior recorded; not a correctness result
status_vocabulary.REPRODUCED: the named source, build or artifact was reproduced
status_vocabulary.OPTIONAL / FUTURE: outside the current X1E release claim; any measured blocker is still recorded and the profile is never reported as supported

capability_contract.goal: Standard desktop OpenGL behavior for ordinary shaderpacks through MobileGlues.
capability_contract.surface: A core version that is actually implemented plus individually earned extensions, covering GLSL translation and program/link state, framebuffer and render-target routing, image/SSBO resource mapping, compute dispatch, and advertised barrier/fence/visibility semantics.
capability_contract.rule: An unimplemented feature remains a named compatibility deviation and is not advertised as a capability. Advertising a core version does not erase a deviation.
implemented_this_cycle: depth-texture filter completeness with truthful application-visible filter state
64-bit timestamp queries through GL_EXT_disjoint_timer_query, advertised only with loaded entry points
program and array image-uniform routing through per-program logical->physical maps

named_deviations.glTextureBarrier: No legal GLES equivalent; not advertised. Pinned Iris uses BufferFlipper alternate textures.
named_deviations.glTextureView: No ES texture views and no GL_EXT_texture_view on X1E; not advertised.
named_deviations.glInvalidateFramebuffer_attachment_mappi: Native forward does not map logical draw-buffer attachments after a shuffle; backlog.
named_deviations.copy_image_format_substitution: Same-format D32F tested; backing-format change copies untested.
named_deviations.depth_filter_scan: Draw-time sampler override handling covers 2D; array/cube/3D sampler overrides and stencil-index mode remain.

capability_contract.non_claim: This does not promise full OpenGL 4.6 conformance.
